routes.label: Find the required number of A grades

question: At the beginning of the school year, Lisa’s goal was to earn an A on at least \(80\%\) of her \(50\) quizzes for the year. She earned an A on \(22\) of the first \(30\) quizzes. If she is to achieve her goal, on at most how many of the remaining quizzes can she earn a grade lower than an A?
solution:
First convert Lisa's percentage goal into a number of quizzes. She needs at least
\[
0.80\cdot50=40
\]
A grades. Since she already has \(22\), she needs at least \(40-22=18\) more. There are \(50-30=20\) quizzes remaining, so at most
\[
20-18=\boxed{2}
\]
can receive grades below A. Earning \(18\) A grades and \(2\) lower grades would give exactly \(40\) A grades, so this maximum is attainable. The answer is choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
